result_of_the_amendment_5_acceptance_tes.winner_by_dev_agreement: Qwen3-14B NF4, prefill-only scoring (T0 11/12; vs gpt-4.1 on DEV P5: kappa_R 0.60 pooled, 0.71 SL, 0.35 EN, agreement 0.95; vs the blind adjudication of 58 FINAL P5 rows: kappa_R 0.49, agreement 0.76)
result_of_the_amendment_5_acceptance_tes.verdict: FAILS the pre-registered gates (kappa >= 0.6 vs gpt-4.1 in EACH language and >= 0.6 vs the adjudication). No available judge passes: gemini-2.5-flash is far worse (kappa 0.17 / 0.19) and gpt-4.1, the only judge that passed T0 12/12, is unreachable because the run budget is exhausted.

consequences_as_pre_registered: The PRIMARY result of this artifact is the JUDGE-FREE representation readout: refusal- and harmfulness-direction retention at the last prefix token, per language and prefix length, on item-matched prompts. It needs no labels and was captured in the same forward pass as every generation.

Every judged statistic (DG, DGN, DDG, curves, cross-language 2x2, recovery, restoration, collateral) is reported as a FLAGGED readout with the measured judge error attached, never as a validated result. The pre-registered H_depth verdict is reported as 'not evaluable with a validated judge'.

Judged statistics are computed under the local judge (primary readout) AND under gemini-2.5-flash (the API readout that exists for tier A), so the paper can show how much each conclusion depends on the instrument. No cross-judge fallback is used inside a cell.

The frozen m (0.5633, from DEV under gemini prompt v2) is kept as the frozen value, since it was fixed before any FINAL statistic. m recomputed from the local DEV labels is reported beside it as a sensitivity row.

The blind Claude adjudication is extended from 58 to about 120 FINAL P5 rows, stratified on the LOCAL judge's label so the strata have known weights, to give a per-language estimate of judge error on the primary cells. It is a third LLM reader, not human review.
